material.title: Acme Memory to add 60,000 wafers per month of HBM4 capacity, first output in Q3 2027
material.bodyOriginal: Acme Memory will invest $12 billion to add 60,000 wafers per month of HBM4 capacity at its new fab, with first output scheduled for Q3 2027. The company said its 2027 HBM supply is fully booked by three accelerator customers.
